scope: Study sequencing only: 228 design identities/families/variants are not 228 independent meshes.
authorityPolicy: No ownership, reservation, acceptance, selection or runtime installation is granted by this queue.

referenceAudit.policy: Availability is an audited snapshot, not visual approval; inspect each licensed reference before generation.
referenceAudit.blockerPolicy: 34 Hellfire graphics lack local objcurs2; Lightforge has unresolved LGTFORGE source. Never substitute Bovine Plate.
referenceAudit.indirectPolicy: The ear master uses the three class-variant references; Shirotachi uses the available GREAT_SWORD cursor.

sequencingPolicy.initialBatchException: Existing nine-item handoff is preserved as one batch.
sequencingPolicy.conceptPolicy: Concept status and all revisions come from the overlay. No latest revision is selected; existing candidates require review, not regeneration.
sequencingPolicy.reusePolicy: Shared cursors, spell/affix variants and family sheets do not imply independent meshes or automatic concept approval.
sequencingPolicy.integrationGate: Concept review precedes master production; character sockets/grip/skin and ground/equipped/icon identity remain separate gates.
